# Agenda 0.5.0
- Uses Apple’s on-device Foundation Models framework first when shortening long todo descriptions on supported Macs. - Enforces a deterministic title contract: one line, at most eight words and 60 characters, with `FR:`, `BUG:`, and `NIT:` prefixes preserved. - Keeps the full original todo description in its context notes. - Falls back to configured remote providers and then safe local truncation when the on-device model is unavailable. - Prevents a delayed Keychain lookup from blocking Agenda’s window and local server during startup.

# Agenda 0.4.0
- Adds a privacy-safe agent integration pack for Cursor and Claude Code, available from **Settings → Reveal Agent Integration Pack…**. - Adds related-todo search guidance and portable pickup/closeout rules while preserving human ownership of task status and review decisions. - Publishes the agent pack as a separate ZIP beside the Agenda DMG. - Moves bug reports to the public Agenda release tracker without attaching local server logs automatically.

# Agenda 0.3.4
- Fixes “Launch Agenda at login” showing “Installed app not found” on a fresh installation. - Login-item registration now handles macOS's initial not-found state and can be disabled and re-enabled reliably.
